anticoagulant_mentions.quote: HPI: Patient with atrial fibrillation with prior TIA (CHA2DS2-VASc 3, HAS-BLED 1) maintained on warfarin 5 mg PO daily (INR goal 2-3). No history of major bleeding. Prior TIA without residual deficits; no stroke. Reports good adherence. Denies palpitations or presyncope.

1. Stop warfarin 5 days before surgery (last dose 03/13/2026); check INR the day before surgery with goal <1.5. Bridge with enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SC q12h starting 3 days prior, last dose 24 hours pre-op. Resume warfarin at the usual home dose the evening of surgery if hemostasis is adequate, with enoxaparin bridging restarted 48-72 hours post-op until INR is therapeutic.
- apixaban 5 mg PO BID - taking as prescribed
- Note: patient states warfarin was stopped last month and replaced with Eliquis by cardiology.
